verdict.rationale: Stripe's own features run as configured, autonomous background processes. Billing automates recurring payments, trials and renewals, and Smart Retries automatically retry failed payments with no code required. However, these are fixed, domain-specific automations, not a first-party builder for user-defined automations. The Kyber no-code workflow builder is a third-party Stripe App, and webhooks/event destinations are only developer building blocks, so neither earns credit. missing for 10: a first-party user-configurable automation/workflow builder (triggers, conditions, actions), agent-driven scheduled or background task execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
